python3 - <<'PY'
p='tests/ir_backend_smoke_test.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = '        "aa\\n|aa|FE|8|7|"'
new = '        "aa\\n|bb|FE|8|7|"'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2 = "/// Verifies `SplFileObject` lightweight state getters and byte reads lower to EIR."
new2 = ("/// Verifies `SplFileObject` lightweight state getters and byte reads lower to EIR.\n"
        "///\n"
        "/// The `fgetc()` pair reads `bb`, not `aa`: `getCurrentLine()` is php's ALIAS of `fgets()`\n"
        "/// and CONSUMES the first line. This assertion read `aa` while elephc answered the cached\n"
        "/// current line without advancing the stream — measured on `php -n` 8.5.6, this exact\n"
        "/// program prints `aa\\n|bb|FE|8|7|`.")
assert s.count(old2)==1
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('smoke test corrected')
PY
cargo build 2>&1 | rg "^error|^warning" -A6 | head -12; echo BUILD_DONE: smoke test corrected BUILD_DONE
